assertions.assertion: The claim was denied under code CO-197
The denial reason is missing precertification

The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and a history of atrial fibrillation, raising concern for intermittent arrhythmia recurrence. Given the personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction, continuous monitoring is indicated to detect potential embolic sources or rhythm disturbances that may have been missed on standard ECG.
